title: Ant International-SRE Engineer (US)-Americas & EMEA Tech
description:
AUS Merchant Service.INC as known as Alipay that is committed to democratizing payment services and empowering people and businesses to join and thrive in the global economy. Alipay at its core is a group of engineers that are dedicated in building cutting edge, highly reliable, highly scalable and high throughput payment system. Here at Ant Group, you will have a positive impact to the world. You will learn and build the most exciting and most capable large-scale payment system with engineers like you with passion. A career at Alipay is more than just a job. It’s a chance to have broader knowledge and learn things from all aspects of how to make payments happen. At Alipay, we value personal growth and always set higher bar, encourage people to come out of comfort zone and make yourself a better you. You can expect to be constantly challenged with interesting technical problems. Our work environment is collaborative, innovative, results-driven, and completely focused on the customer.

AUS Merchant Service.INC North American Technology team is looking for a talented, creative, and passionate software engineer to help build a cutting-edge and innovative payment system to solve our merchant and consumer needs. As a self-motivated and enthusiastic member of our team, you will work with extremely talented peers in a fun environment building performance efficient payment authorization services that are highly scalable, configurable and available. You will be encouraged to innovate and move in a fast pace to deliver solution to our customers.

Responsibilities:
● Design and develop solutions to automate the technical operations of large-scale systems, and work closely with teams to improve stability from a Software Development Lifecycle perspective.
● Take the technical effort to strengthen payment system stability, which includes but not limited to the monitoring, logs, dashboard, diagnosis tools etc.; conduct usual drills and develop remedy plans to achieve fast service restoration, and take shifts to respond to production issues across regions.
● Define the indicators to evaluate the performance and runtime of the system to improve the observability, facilitating system development and trouble-shooting process; and, plan the system capacities according to business expansion and scheduled promotions.
● Analyze the production cases, such as performance bottleneck, to conclude the technical best-practices, taking the efforts to achieve the high-availability payment architecture.
● Designing and setting up new IDC; designing and implementing data protection plan to meet the standard requirement.

Qualifications:
● Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science-related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience; with 2 years of working experience in Internet industry preferred;
● Solid knowledge of Computer Science, and familiar with the principles of Operating System (Unix/Linux), Computer Storage, Computer Networking and other related principles.
● Software development experience in at least one programming language, such as Java/Python;
● The strong ability to resolve system problems, good communication skills and a sense of ownership.
● The experiences of Redis, MySQL, Nginx, Kubernetes, Docker/Containers, Function as a service, RPC Framework, and Service Mesh, etc.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $100,000-150,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
Additional benefits for this role may include: company bonus,  401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits etc.

Ant International-US Marketing Specialist-Antom
description:
About the Role
We are reinventing what B2B growth looks like, pushing traditional boundaries to scale our enterprise presence across the US market. As a US Growth & Marketing Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), and offline campaign execution.
This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role designed for a "builder" who brings a unique blend of analytical rigor, creativity, and a hands-on execution mindset. You will own the strategy and execution of high-touch marketing programs designed to accelerate the sales cycle, deepen partner ecosystems, and convert high-value accounts through immersive, localized brand experiences.

What You’ll Do
● Targeted Campaign Architecture: Design, build, and execute end-to-end multi-channel campaigns—with a heavy emphasis on account-based marketing (ABM) and offline experiential marketing—to drive enterprise pipeline.
● High-Touch Strategic Touchpoints: Own the end-to-end planning and execution of localized customer workshops, partner roadshows, roundtables, and industry ecosystem activations aimed at accelerating deal cycles.
● Ecosystem GTM Execution: Partner with our payments ecosystem—including Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Independent Sales Organizations (ISOs), core networks, and platforms—to co-market and execute joint marketing programs that expand our US footprint.
● Cross-Functional Sales Alignment: Partner closely with Sales and Business Development leadership to identify high-priority regional markets and enterprise merchant verticals, deploying hyper-targeted marketing programs that unlock processing volume.
● Data-Driven Optimization: Rigorously track and analyze program performance, lead attribution, and pipeline velocity. Use tools like Excel, SQL, and CRM systems to measure marketing ROI and optimize future campaign investments.

What You Bring
● Operational Excellence: A proven track record of managing complex project timelines and high-stakes budgets for offline programs or large-scale campaigns.
● Analytical Polish: Strong proficiency in data analysis with the ability to turn campaign analytics and volume metrics into actionable pipeline strategies.
● Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to align sales teams, external partners, and executive leadership.
● Adaptability: A thriving-in-chaos mindset suited for a fast-paced fintech environment where you must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution.

What Success Looks Like
● Pipeline & Volume Acceleration: Successfully launching localized, high-touch programs that directly shrink sales cycles and boost processing volume for strategic accounts.
● Seamless Execution: Flawlessly executing a high-volume calendar of offline and ecosystem campaigns on time and within budget.
● Scalable Playbooks: Establishing repeatable marketing playbooks that allow us to scale our regional and partner-led acquisition efforts efficiently across the country.

Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
● 3–7 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or strategic operations (experience within payments, acquiring, or fintech is a strong plus, but not a requirement)
● Proven experience planning and executing multi-channel B2B campaigns, localized market activations, or partner-facing programs
● Experience building programs from "0 to 1" at a high-growth startup or in a strategic business operations role preferred
● Strong track record of managing complex project timelines, external vendors, agency relationships, and budgets
● High proficiency in data analysis using Excel (SQL knowledge is a strong plus)
● Experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce for lead capture, campaign attribution, and pipeline tracking
● Familiarity with the payments ecosystem, merchant acquiring, or integrated payments is a plus

The US base salary range for this full-time position is  $120,000-160,000.  Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Ant International and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant education or training.
